title: A ratio across valuations
hook: Two stated cases: explore the unit behind a sell-to-buy ratio.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the unit behind a sell-to-buy ratio affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Ratio, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the unit behind a sell-to-buy ratio in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy seller asks 26; a buyer offers 10 for the same item. What is the sell-to-buy ratio?
